summary: Updates RFC 5280, the X.509 certificate profile, to align with the 2008 specification for Internationalized Domain Names and to support internationalized email addresses in certificates. It makes name constraints treat ASCII-only and internationalized email addresses the same way. It obsoletes RFC 8399.

eli5.summary: Web addresses and emails can now use letters from many languages. This fixes the rules for certificates, the digital ID cards of websites, so they handle those names correctly.

questions: name constraints for email in certificates
